description: A GET-only probe that reads spreadsheet metadata and the whole ConflictNotices tab to establish the true used-row count.
why_it_exists: Retained 2026-08-24 as the safe way to inspect ConflictNotices before touching it. Despite the name 'Create ConflictNotices Tab' this workflow contains no write node at all - the create path was stripped and only the two reads remain.

expect.used_row_count_source: length of the values array returned by spreadsheets.values.get

assertions: Every HTTP node in this workflow is method GET; a POST or PUT appearing here is a regression.
spreadsheets.values.get returns only the populated range, so the response row count is the true used-row count and must not be read off gridProperties.rowCount.
The workflow name promises a create that the nodes do not perform - any agent relying on the name rather than the nodes will believe a tab was created when nothing was written.
target_unresolved_reason: kind is "integration": not executed by harness/run.js.
